title: [SEP 56] Fund Safenet Aegis to Grow SAFE Token Utility and Sustainability
bodyExcerpt: This proposal requests ~7,400,000 SAFE tokens from the SafeDAO treasury to fund Safenet Aegis over a limited 12-month period. ~5,000,000 SAFE tokens are allocated for validator staking rewards and ~2,400,000 SAFE is allocated as milestone-based grants to six genesis Sentinels.
